snippet.title: Crown Of Blight Trailer
snippet.description:
Crown Of Blight is an upcoming dark fantasy, top-down 3D souls-like metroidvania and action-adventure video game developed by a solo developer.
About the Game:
Master challenging combat, explore a non-linear interconnected world, and face brutal bosses in this grim atmospheric journey. Every corner hides a secret, and every mistake could be your last.
#CrownOfBlight
